response.original_title: !New~Passenger! How Do I Add a New Passenger to My Costa Cruise?
response.overview: The first step when you want to add passengers to your Costa Cruise is to review your existing reservation +1-855-732-4023. Keep your booking number, sailing date, ship name, cabin information, and the names of the passengers already included in the reservation available +1-855-732-4023. These details can help Costa or your travel agency locate the correct booking and determine whether another passenger can be accommodated. One of the most important factors is the capacity of your cabin +1-855-732-4023. Costa states that its cabins can accommodate a maximum of four guests, although the exact accommodation available can depend on the specific cabin and ship +1-855-732-4023. Therefore, if you already have passengers booked in your cabin, you should confirm whether there is enough permitted occupancy for the additional traveler.
